title: ASML Breaks Ground on New Dutch Campus: What Changes for Lithography Tool Supply?
excerpt: On September 8, 2026, ASML announced it had started construction on a new industrial campus in the Netherlands. A beginner-friendly look at the plan to complete Phase 1 in 2029, the role of lithography tools, what the figure of up to 20,000 people means, and what to check next.
